title: Tricuspidate
summary: TRICUS'PIDATE, adjective [Latin tres, three, and cuspis, a point.] In botany, three-pointed; ending in three points; as a tricuspidate stamen.

inlines.v: TRICUS'PIDATE, adjective [Latin tres, three, and cuspis, a point.] In botany, three-pointed; ending in three points; as a tricuspidate stamen.
